                                 From the Principal’s Desk




The inception of Tinsukia College in the year 1956 was the result of the strenuous efforts of citizens
of Tinsukia who mobilized all required resources to give rise to the great institution. The college who
has completed sixty-nine years of its glorious existence is a premier institution of higher education in
the North East part of Assam catering the needs of higher education not only to the citizens of Assam
but also the adjoining districts of Arunachal Pradesh. The college has made a rapid stride on the merit
of its students, the dedication of the faculties and the vision of the principals. An institution which
initiated its academic journey with handful of students and four faculty members has now grown into
a huge family with an enrolment of more than 4,000 students and around 80 faculties contributing to
the growth of this premier institution of higher education. This co-ed institution has been imparting
education at all levels of education i.e. Higher Secondary, Degree & Master level respectively in 5
faculties of Arts, Science, Commerce, Management and Computer Science. Currently, the college has
altogether 19 teaching departments at UG level, 4 departments at Master degree levels Viz.- M. Com,
M. Sc in Mathematics, M. Sc. in Chemistry and M. Sc in Computer Science. Besides, it provides two
Professional Degree courses, Viz.- BBA and BCA. The college has a study centre of Krishna Kanta
Handiqui State Open University (KKHSOU) which offers several UG, PG, Diploma and Certificate
programmes.

The College has State of Arts infrastructure to support the holistic development of the students. It has
taken initiative to make the entire teaching learning process, students centric and interactive with the
help of smart class rooms. The entire admission process is fully computerized which is beneficial to
all stakeholders.

We hope that Tinsukia College will rise up to the expectation of all and make us all proud as
stakeholder of this great institution.

Tinsukia College-A Profile

   The inception of Tinsukia College in the year 1956 was the result of the strenuous efforts
   of Late B. K. Saraswatji who mobilized all required resources with the help of
   likeminded citizens of Tinsukia, a part of the then Lakhimpur District to give rise to this
   great institution. Without their support and patronage, the college would never have
   come into being. Before the college came to be located in the present premises at
   Kachujan, in 1961; it started out in the present premises of Senairam Higher Secondary
   School on 1st September, 1956. The college started as an Arts College initially at
   intermediate level but in the very next year Commerce stream was introduced. In 1957
   itself the college was upgraded to Degree level. The year 1964 has a special significance
   in the annals of Tinsukia College when Science stream was also added making it a full-
   fledged Degree college. For an educational institution to rise to this level within a span
   of eight years of its inception is a feat in itself. Till 1964, courses were conducted under
   the auspices of Gauhati University but with the establishment of Dibrugarh University in
   1965, the college was brought under its jurisdiction. Until 1961 this institution was run
   by the benevolent contributions of the public, but in 1962 it was accorded the status of
   “Deficit-in-aid” college enabling the college to receive financial grant from the Govt. of
   Assam. Later on in 1969, with the recognition of the University Grants Commission,
   New Delhi, the college became eligible for receipt of planned financial assistance for
   development schemes. Later the Govt. of Assam took a historic decision to provincialise
   all deficit grant-in-aid colleges w.e.f. 1st December 2005 and subsequently Tinsukia
   College enjoys the status of Provincialised College.

   The college made a gradual growth on the merit of its students, the dedication of
   teachers and the vision of the principals. An institution which initiated its academic
   endeavour with handful students and four faculty members now has grown into a huge
   family with an enrolment of more than 3500 students and a teaching fraternity with
   almost 80 members contributing to the growth of this premier institution of higher
   education. This Co-ed institution has been imparting education both at Higher Secondary
   & Degree levels in 5 faculties of Arts, Science, Commerce, Management and Computer
   Science. Currently the college has altogether 19 departments, viz. Assamese, Bengali,
   Botany, Chemistry, Commerce, Computer Science, Economics, English, Education,
   Geography, Hindi, History, Mathematics, Philosophy, Physics, Political Science,
   Sociology, Statistics and Zoology. Besides, it provides two professional degree courses,
   viz, Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) and Bachelor of Computer Application
   (BCA). The college has a study centre of Krishna Kanta Handiqui State Open University
   under which several UG and PG courses are offered.

       of approximately 50000 Books including some rare publications. Besides reference

       well furnished hostel with all basic facilities. The boarding capacity of the hostel is
       124 and total number of vacant seats will be available after giving accommodation
       to old bonafide students. The seats are allotted to the students on the basis of merit
       as well as the distance from their residence. The main purpose of the hostel is to
       cater the needs of girls who hail from distant and remote areas of Tinsukia district
       and the neighbouring state of Arunachal Pradesh.

       “Natghar” Auditorium Hall: It enables an audience a larger space for
       experiencing academic and cultural activities

       AC Conference Halls : There are two Audio Visual rooms in the college where
       all sorts of modern facilities are available for organizing Departmental Seminars

General Discipline

1) Joining our institution means that you agree to obey our statutes, regulations & codes of
conduct, which codify the good manners & responsible behaviours. We expect you to behave
as a good citizen & not undermine the reputation of the institute.

2) All forms of ragging in hostel & college campus are strictly prohibited. Strong disciplinary
action will be taken and one has to face the trial by laws in the court if found to be involved
in ragging. The undertaking attached/in the website of the College must be submitted at the
time of admission duly signed by the student and parents by all students before the
interview/counselling board.

3) Students’ Union shall also be subjected to such rules & regulations as the college
administration prescribes from time to time.

4) All powers of maintenance of discipline are vested with the Head of the Institution and his
decision shall be final in such matters.

5) Any notice desired to be pasted or circulated by the students anywhere in the college &
hostel premises will need the prior approval of the college authority.

6) Mobile phones are not to be used inside classrooms without the teacher’s approval.
Moreover, mobile phones should be kept in silent mode inside the campus.

7) Chewing Gutkha/Paan inside college premises is a cognizable offence.


8) Unruly and odd behaviour in and around college and hostel campus will be dealt seriously.

9) Students must keep their bicycles in the College Cycle Stand under chain and lock (double
lock) to protect from thieves. College will not take any responsibility if cycle is lost due to
thefts. Our College security guard will keep vigilant the cycle stand during College hours.
Bikes must be kept outside the campus.
10) College uniform is compulsory during college hours inside the campus, without which no
student will be allowed to enter the campus.

N.B. Aimless loitering, grouping or pairing and gossiping restricted in the college campus.
